stem: Which statement best describes how the poet uses rhyme in each stanza of the poem?

options.label: F
options.text: Only the second and fourth lines rhyme.

options.label: G
options.text: Only the first and third lines rhyme.

options.label: H
options.text: The first and third lines rhyme, and the second and fourth lines rhyme.

options.label: J
options.text: The first and second lines rhyme, and the third and fourth lines rhyme.
